notes: Identity assessment: title and all six title-page authors match the neutral Holbrook et al. reference. Source header names https://osf.io/download/8jdpm/. The supplied text is an empirical primary manuscript with methods, results, tables, references and supplementary materials, rather than an abstract or preregistration. The requested preprint DOI and version date are not independently established by the title page; no network verification performed. No source PDF is supplied. Only Flanker Task and p. 40 are specified; printed p. 40 is a reference list in this version. The locator does not distinguish direct coefficient-alpha analyses from conceptual dependability analyses, trial cutoffs, ERN versus difference scores, or multiple pairwise contrasts. Target test and sample correspondence remain unresolved. Candidates only: Aim 1 coefficient alpha 0.45 at 7 error trials, with analytic participant n=181 (p. 15 footnote 5); Aim 2 dependability 0.41 at the same task-specific cutoff (p. 16); Table 2 overall ERN dependability .86 (p. 43); Table 3 gives multiple ERN/ΔERN task contrasts with 20-trial/all-trial dependability and ICC columns (p. 45). These distinct printed metrics are not identified as d. No effect-size conversion performed. The explicitly reported final study n=182 is only a model/sample candidate for unresolved target purposes. The fully within-person extension has n=124; residualized difference-score analyses use other cutoff-dependent Ns. No N was summed or inferred from df. Candidate alpha results give confidence intervals; conceptual results and Bayesian contrasts give credible intervals. No p was inferred from intervals or borrowed from separate error-trial-count chi-square comparisons. Original and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
